source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the power status of LED light control
1. Turn on system and check Power status should shown On
2. Shutdown system and check Power status should shown off

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

original_test_intent: Verify the BMC WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs power-status indication changes consistently with the actual system being stably on and stably off.
original_method: Validate the exact WebUI field and authoritative chassis/host power telemetry; capture a stable initial state; with maintenance approval use the supported graceful power-on or shutdown operation to create only the missing state; for each state correlate timestamped WebUI, validated API/BMC telemetry and independent host/console evidence after bounded stabilization; restore the approved final state and verify OS/storage/device health.
manual_activity: An owner corrects the acceptance criteria, maps the UI and power fields, approves the maintenance window, transition method and final state. Protected telemetry/polling can be automated; a human authorizes each service-impacting power action, observes recovery and owns the verdict.
required_inputs: BMC/SUT identity, firmware and WebUI revision
Validated resource and trusted TLS/credential mechanism
Approved graceful transition method and maintenance window
Required final state and post-transition health matrix
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL, BMC or OS logs; preserve the evidence needed to diagnose the power transitions.
Do not use `curl -k`, place credentials in process-visible arguments or assume `/redfish/v1/Chassis/system`; validate the service root and certificate trust.
Do not treat IndicatorLED/UID as equivalent to actual host PowerState unless the vendor mapping explicitly says so.
Read-only telemetry may be collected without a power write, but it cannot claim the full on/off functional coverage.
Before each transition verify the target, workload, storage and OS state, obtain explicit approval and use only the supported graceful operation.
Never hard-off, reset or blindly retry. Stop on timeout, stale/mismatched telemetry, console loss or storage/device errors and use the independent recovery path.
After stabilization, restore the approved final state and prove OS, storage, devices and unrelated BMC settings remain healthy.
agent_execution_scope: Validate the exact target, UI/API schema, field semantics, TLS, credentials, baseline and transition plan.
Collect timestamped stable-state WebUI/API/BMC/console evidence without clearing logs.
After point-of-action approval, invoke only the approved graceful transition needed for the matrix and poll boundedly with no retry.
Correlate the stable on/off states and detect stale, unknown or inconsistent telemetry.
Verify and restore the approved final state, archive health/audit evidence and return facts without DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Replace the unrelated UID Criteria in the Review layer with measurable Power-status on/off acceptance while preserving Master.
Approve the exact UI/LED/PowerState mapping, graceful transition method, timing, maintenance window, final state and recovery.
Review the complete on/off correlation and health evidence and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A validated chassis GET can supplement evidence, but the proposed command disables TLS verification, exposes credentials, assumes the resource and conflates PowerState with IndicatorLED. Most importantly, it never creates or observes both source-required power states and therefore cannot prove the functional case.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Discover the authoritative Redfish resource over trusted TLS with protected credentials, collect complete power/status telemetry, and pair it with the preserved WebUI and independent console evidence before and after separately approved graceful on/off transitions.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs path, on/off operations, power-status wording, unrelated UID Criteria, no Script/Bundle and 2/0-minute estimates are all preserved; the timing may need Project correction rather than silent extension.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a two-state timestamped correlation matrix across WebUI, validated API/BMC telemetry and independent host/console evidence, using approved graceful transitions and bounded stabilization.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The selected BMC WebUI and chassis/host power-control implementation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC firmware, WebUI build, Redfish schema and host/OS version.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor power-state/indicator mapping and Project availability/shutdown/recovery policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authoritative mapping, protected transport, independent ground truth, bounded polling and recovery without deleting the original WebUI and transition coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: API telemetry is an override/supplement, not proof of WebUI presentation; a single current-state read is partial evidence and does not cover both on and off behavior.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Corrected Criteria, resource/UI mapping, maintenance approval, timing and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Power transitions can interrupt workloads or storage and transient states can make snapshots misleading.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish/vendor API may be approved for the transition or telemetry only when the original WebUI method, actual method, reason, engineer approval, state/field equivalence and uncovered UI coverage are recorded. Read-only substitution cannot claim the source on/off test passed.
expected_evidence: Approval, target/BMC/WebUI/schema identity, corrected acceptance, validated TLS/resource and pre-transition host/workload/storage baseline
Timestamped complete WebUI and protected API/BMC status for stable on and stable off states, with exact field/LED mapping
Independent console/host evidence and graceful power-action audit forming an ordered transition timeline
Bounded polling outcomes including transient/stale/unknown handling and no unapproved reset/retry
Final approved power state, OS/storage/device/log health comparison and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and Procedure test power-status display across on/off states, but the sole Criteria says `UID behavior should be expected`, which is a different indicator function. The acceptance must be corrected in the Review layer while the conflicting Master text remains preserved.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The power-status purpose and state transitions are clear. The incorrect Criteria, mapping and maintenance inputs are resolvable engineer/Project decisions, so execution readiness is pending rather than permanently BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Prevents an unsafe no-risk power transition and false PASS from UID/IndicatorLED or one API snapshot, while preserving the functional on/off WebUI coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Host PowerState, chassis indicator state and a UID locator are separate concepts. The Master requires actual on and off states, so telemetry alone is insufficient; however, creating those states can disrupt workload and storage. A valid SIT method therefore combines approved graceful transitions, stable-state polling, WebUI evidence and independent console/host truth, with recovery and health checks.
